name: PlanetScale
tagline: Serverless Postgres/Vitess with CLI, API, branches, and MCP.
shortDescription: PlanetScale provides database branching, service tokens, CLI API passthrough, and an MCP server command.
agentSummary: Agents can branch databases, inspect schemas, manage deploy requests, and use CLI/MCP surfaces for database workflows.
bestFor: Database branching, schema review, deploy requests, and agent-safe data workflows.
cautionNotes: Key limitations: Production schema deploys and data changes need review and backups. Schema changes, migrations, deletes, backups, row-level security, and retention policies need explicit review before agents touch production data. MCP servers inherit the connected account's scopes and may send prompts or data to third-party services; configure read-only or narrow scopes when available. CLI access is powerful but can run destructive local or production commands; prefer dry runs, preview environments, and non-production credentials.
pricingSummary: Public pricing by organization, database, storage, and usage.
authModel: OAuth login, service tokens, org/database permissions, and CLI config.
browserSupport: Dashboard helps review branches, deploy requests, and usage.

capabilities.detail: pscale CLI includes API passthrough, branch workflows, and MCP install/server commands.
PlanetScale API supports databases, branches, deploy requests, and service tokens.
